business_problem: Agility is a key advantage for companies in every industry, but it can be a business-defining edge for retail. Chalhoub Group, a regional luxury retailer headquartered in the United Arab Emirates, was looking to improve the HR approval process, removing the need for consolidating and accessing data from scattered platforms. Microsoft Fabric allowed Chalhoub Group’s HR function to modernize its data analytics and streamline its data sources into one platform, increasing agility, enhancing analytics, and accelerating processes.
solution_summary: Chalhoub Group used Microsoft Fabric, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Power BI to unify data and reporting on a shared analytics foundation.
